summary: Frozen PR-289 R2 code/harness review fails one required policy cell. Full exported semantic replay, real repeated-role ordinal completeness, verified-byte factory execution under hostile import state, interpreter-alias invariant replay including Python 3.10, 32 ordered mutations, archive containment, receipt replay, and all eight policy commands pass. Output-parent identity pinning remains incomplete for both build and check: a parent swap after the last pathname assertion but before the descriptor-relative operation yields false success against a detached directory.

findings.title: Late output-parent replacement makes build and check report false success
findings.proposition: The runner's final pathname identity assertion precedes the descriptor-relative write or read. If the parent path is replaced in that interval, the pinned descriptor continues to access the detached original directory, but build/check still return zero and report the advertised repository path as valid.

evidence_references.note: build asserts pathname parent before os.replace and has no post-replace pathname assertion
check asserts pathname parent before reading via the pinned descriptor and has no post-read pathname assertion
assignment-local late build and late check replacement reproducers

observed.build: return_code=0; success JSON names docs/generated/pr289_data_identity_v2_receipt.json; advertised output absent; receipt exists only in detached prior parent
observed.check: return_code=0; success JSON reports detached receipt digest; ATTACKER bytes occupy the advertised receipt path

findings.expected: Any replacement of the advertised output parent before the write/check linearization point must fail closed and must not produce a successful receipt or replay report.
assumptions: A concurrent local actor can rename and replace docs/generated while the runner is active.
The required policy cell covers build and check parent replacement, not only redirection outside the repository.
A zero exit with the advertised path absent or containing different bytes violates generated-artifact integrity even when descriptor-relative operations remain confined to the detached directory.
findings.recommended_change: Add a post-operation parent identity assertion after os.replace/fsync in build and after the descriptor-relative read in check. Preserve descriptor-relative no-follow I/O. Add discriminating late-race tests for both paths that replace the parent immediately before the actual replace/read and require a nonzero/exception outcome; regenerate the receipt and all candidate-bound hashes afterward.
findings.kill_switch: Do not admit the code/harness review, reseal, or publish PR-289 while this policy cell is FAIL. A new candidate invalidates this review and requires fresh R2 evidence.
